cd /home/ploi/tecnogen.ar
mkdir -p public

cat << 'B64EOF' > /tmp/dist_tecnogen.base64

B64EOF

base64 -d /tmp/dist_tecnogen.base64 > /tmp/dist_tecnogen.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/dist_tecnogen.tar.gz -C public/
tar -xzf /tmp/dist_tecnogen.tar.gz -C ./
rm -f /tmp/dist_tecnogen.base64 /tmp/dist_tecnogen.tar.gz

chmod -R 755 public ./
echo '🚀 TecnoGen Web desplegado y activo en producción (tecnogen.ar)!'
